summary: checkpoint_context and cross_context_boundary hold every step. record_delivery advances an external-effect step only after a fenced start with no later dispatch. accept_worker_result advances only for the exact completed attempt. record_worker_failure records the exact failed attempt without advancing, after which a fresh fenced start can lead to record_delivery or a successful lane acceptance. record_decision and accept_decision advance the architecture-spike path to premise confirmation.
title: record_delivery exits the step a session executed
